# PRO X Wireless Gaming Headset 046D:0ABA: its USB dongle exposes only the
# long HID++ collection (usage page 0xFF43, usage 0x0202), so every request is
# a long (0x11) frame addressed to device index 0xFF.
#
# Synthetic transcript: frames built from the layouts in Linux
# drivers/hid/hid-logitech-hidpp.c (long 0x11 reports, 0x1F20 ADC measurement
# event `hidpp20_adc_measurement_event_1f20`) and Solaar
# lib/logitech_receiver (base.py ping accepting index 0x00 for 0xFF,
# hidpp20.py feature calls). Feature indexes are made up. Replace with a real
# capture in Task 14.
#
# Format: `out <short|long> <hex>` is a frame BatterySight writes, `in` one it
# reads; frames shorter than their role (7 / 20 bytes) are zero-padded. The
# `out` lines after an `in` are the writes that frame causes.

# Group arrival: ping index 0xFF.
out long 11 FF 00 1B 00 00 5A
# The dongle answers with the complementary index 0x00: protocol 4.2.
in  long 11 00 00 1B 04 02 5A
# Root getFeature 0x0005 -> absent: name and kind fall back.
out long 11 FF 00 0B 00 05 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
# Root getFeature 0x0003 -> absent: key falls back to pid and index.
out long 11 FF 00 0B 00 03 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
# Battery features in preference order: 0x1004, 0x1000, 0x1001 absent ...
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 04 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 00 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
out long 11 FF 00 0B 10 01 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 00
# ... 0x1F20 (ADC measurement) at index 8.
out long 11 FF 00 0B 1F 20 00
in  long 11 FF 00 0B 08
# 0x1F20 fn 0: 3828 mV, discharging -> 68 % on the PRO X curve -> registered.
out long 11 FF 08 0B 00 00 00
in  long 11 FF 08 0B 0E F4 01
# Broadcast with flags 0x0F: headset switched off -> asleep, level kept.
in  long 11 FF 08 00 0E F4 0F
# Broadcast: back on, 3971 mV charging -> 87 %.
in  long 11 FF 08 00 0F 83 03
